prompt:
Create one original shipping background plate for Emberfall: Ashen Veil, a mature dark fantasy action RPG. Native very wide landscape, requested 2240 x 1000 pixels, 2.24:1 aspect ratio, opaque full frame. This is a DISTANT ENVIRONMENT BACKDROP behind live isometric 3D game geometry, not a whole gameplay screenshot, not a concept-art poster. Believable high-end real-time game material rendering: physically convincing aged masonry, careful roughness, restrained cinematic light, cold deep shadows with readable midtones, moderate exposure, low saturation. Use the grounded material realism and disciplined value hierarchy of Diablo Immortal as a high-level visual reference, while inventing original architecture and never copying Blizzard locations, symbols, characters, or buildings.

Composition: a wide view from slightly above floor height into a deep enclosed architectural volume, with strong depth formed by receding side aisles. Crisp stone details at upper and far side edges. Keep the CENTER and LOWER HALF quiet, relatively dark, low-detail and low-contrast, suitable for foreground game geometry and animated characters placed later. Broad shadowed stone floor recedes gently into darkness. The upper architecture supplies atmosphere; no central hero prop or giant bright focal point. The room feels physically enclosed, oppressive and threatening, never like a floating stage. Small localized light sources only, clear directional lighting, no broad bloom, no huge bright windows or overexposed light shafts.

DROWNED ARCHIVE. A sunken monastic library enclosed within heavy oxidized gray-green stone walls. Thick square pillars, water-stained rib vaults, decayed dark timber library galleries, distant closed shelves, and recessed stone reading niches frame the outer edges. Near-black teal floodwater quietly covers the broad lower floor and reflects only broken dim hints of the architecture, with no bright glossy mirror. Sparse spectral jade light leaks weakly from a few far recessed alcoves, occupying less than three percent of the image. No giant glowing magical object, no central desk, no floating books. Quiet recessed central space, darker low-contrast lower half, subtle wet mineral deposits and algae only near the edges. A cold, drowned, abandoned sanctuary with realistic mass and decay.

No text, lettering, runes, labels, UI, border, logo, watermark, people, characters, monsters, animals, weapons, foreground hero, ornate gold ribbons, gilded ornamental framing, bright fantasy clouds, purple fog spectacle, candy colors, painterly brush strokes, cartoon styling, photographic film grain, or floating structures. Fill the whole image with the environment. Only the original environment plate.

visual_inspection.result: Pass: flooded library; heavy oxidized stone and dark timber; near-black teal water; small jade alcove lights; empty central water.
